collection.title: Ferrari 456 1998 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ferrari 456 1998 - 2004 requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
